title: Kanuri people - Wikipedia
text: The Kanuri people (also Barnawi, Yerwa, Barebari and several other subgroup names) are an African ethnic group living largely in the lands of the former Kanem and Bornu Empires in Niger, Nigeria, Chad, and Cameroon, as well as a diaspora community residing in Sudan. [6]

title: Who Are the Kanuri People? A Cultural Introduction
text: Language and Identity The Kanuri speak Kanuri, a member of the Saharan branch of the Nilo-Saharan language family, with dialects such as Yerwa Kanuri, Manga Kanuri, and Bilma Kanuri.
